purpose: Paired exploratory official-game comparison of weighted versus unweighted task-choice BC, against two frozen opponents.
panel: First three of six seeds reserved before weighted fit; round2 and market; both seats; both models; 24 games and 24 primary replays; one separate 719-transition replay. Remaining three seeds unopened.
acceptance: Every game 720 states, 719 actions, both DONE, zero errors, verified engine, models and replay receipts. Three seed clusters; 10000 seed-cluster bootstrap draws descriptive only.
exploratory_guards: Each paired seed/opponent/seat own profit and cash margin delta >= -2000; per seed/opponent seat-mean deltas >= -1000; no promotion or significance claim.
resources: Three 4GiB available-memory samples before each match, 2GiB sampled host floor, bounded Job and four-hour deadline; sampling is not a hard system/GPU cap.
stop_conditions: Any identity, resource, game, replay or cleanup failure after marker stops without retry, replacement or adaptive extra seeds.
boundaries: No retraining, BC data collection, PPO, tuning, model promotion, default Bot or official rule modification. Raw replays, logs and models stay private.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and code review, not WebChat.
